parts.zh: 上个月，Google的一辆自动驾驶汽车在加利福尼亚州撞上了一辆公交车
W: 嗯,我们可以为您叫辆出租车
M: 听起来不错。但班车能让我准时到达机场吗?
W: 可以的,应该没问题
M: 太好了!我就在大堂等着
M: 现在我想结算一下迷你吧的账单
W: 我看看。总共是37.50美元

items.stem: According to Google, what was the cause of the accident?

choices.text: The self-driving system was faulty.
choices.zh: 自动驾驶系统出现了故障。

choices.text: The car was moving at a fast speed.
choices.zh: 汽车行驶速度过快。

choices.text: The man in the car was absent-minded.
choices.zh: 车内的男子心不在焉。

choices.text: The test driver made a wrong judgment.
choices.zh: 测试驾驶员做出了错误的判断。

items.stem: How have Google's self-driving cars performed so far?

choices.text: They have generally done quite well.
choices.zh: 它们总体上表现得相当好。

choices.text: They have caused several severe crashes.
choices.zh: 它们已经造成了几起严重的撞车事故。

choices.text: They have posed a threat to other drivers.
choices.zh: 它们对其他驾驶员构成了威胁。

choices.text: They have done better than conventional cars.
choices.zh: 它们的表现优于传统汽车。

items.stem: What do we learn about Tom Moses?

choices.text: He is a queen bee specialist.
choices.zh: 他是蜂王专家。

choices.text: He works at a national park.
choices.zh: 他在国家公园工作。

choices.text: He removed the bees from the boot.
choices.zh: 他把蜜蜂从后备箱移走了。

choices.text: He drove the bees away from his car.
choices.zh: 他把蜜蜂从他的车上赶走了。

items.stem: What do we know about the bees on the back of the car?

choices.text: They were making a lot of noise
choices.zh: 它们发出很大的噪音

choices.text: They were looking after the queen
choices.zh: 它们在照看蜂王

choices.text: They were dancing in a unique way
choices.zh: 它们以独特的方式跳舞

choices.text: They were looking for a new box to live in
choices.zh: 它们在寻找新的居住地

items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: The latest test on a rare animal species
choices.zh: 对一种稀有动物物种的最新测试

choices.text: The finding of two new species of frog
choices.zh: 两个青蛙新物种的发现

choices.text: The second trip to a small remote
choices.zh: 第二次前往一个偏远小地方的旅行

choices.text: The discovery of a new species of snake
choices.zh: 一个蛇类新物种的发现

items.stem: What do we learn about the scientific team leader?

choices.text: He fell from a tall palm tree by accident
choices.zh: 他意外地从一棵高大的棕榈树上摔下来

choices.text: A snake crawled onto his head in his sleep
choices.zh: 一条蛇在他睡觉时爬到了他的头上

choices.text: He discovered a rare frog on a deserted island
choices.zh: 他在一个荒岛上发现了一种稀有青蛙

choices.text: A poisonous snake attacked him on his field trip
choices.zh: 一条毒蛇在他野外考察时袭击了他

items.stem: How did the newly discovered creature get its name?

choices.text: From its origin
choices.zh: 根据它的起源

choices.text: From its length
choices.zh: 根据它的长度

choices.text: From its colour
choices.zh: 根据它的颜色

choices.text: From its genes
choices.zh: 根据它的基因

items.stem: Why does the man ask about the quickest way to the airport?

choices.text: The airport is a long way from the hotel
choices.zh: 机场离酒店很远

choices.text: His flight is leaving in less than 2 hours
choices.zh: 他的航班不到两小时后起飞

choices.text: He has to check a lot of luggage
choices.zh: 他有很多行李要托运

choices.text: The security check takes time
choices.zh: 安检需要时间

items.stem: How is the man going to pay his bill?

choices.text: In cash
choices.zh: 现金支付

choices.text: By credit card
choices.zh: 信用卡支付

choices.text: With his smart phone
choices.zh: 用他的智能手机支付

choices.text: With a traveler's check
choices.zh: 用旅行支票支付

items.stem: What did the man ask the woman to do?

choices.text: Look after his luggage
choices.zh: 照看他的行李

choices.text: Find a porter for him
choices.zh: 为他找一名搬运工

choices.text: Give him a receipt
choices.zh: 给他一张收据

choices.text: Confirm his flight
choices.zh: 确认他的航班

items.stem: What favor does the woman ask of the man?

choices.text: Posting a comment on the hotel's webpage
choices.zh: 在酒店网页上发表评论

choices.text: Staying in the same hotel next time he comes
choices.zh: 下次再来时入住同一家酒店

choices.text: Signing up for membership of Sheraton Hotel
choices.zh: 注册Sheraton Hotel会员

choices.text: Loading her luggage onto the airport shuttle
choices.zh: 把她的行李搬上机场班车

items.stem: What does the man say about Ben?

choices.text: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the conversation you have just heard.
choices.zh: 第12至15题基于你刚才听到的对话。

choices.text: He is the only boy in his family
choices.zh: 他是家里唯一的男孩

choices.text: He is his teacher's favorite student
choices.zh: 他是老师最喜欢的学生

choices.text: He has stopped making terrible faces
choices.zh: 他已经不再做可怕的鬼脸了

items.stem: What did aunt Mary use to do when the man was a child?

choices.text: Warn him of danger by making up a story
choices.zh: 通过编故事警告他有危险

choices.text: Give him some cherry stones to play with
choices.zh: 给他一些樱桃核玩

choices.text: Do something funny to amuse him
choices.zh: 做些有趣的事逗他开心

choices.text: Tell him to play in her backyard
choices.zh: 让他在她的后院玩

items.stem: What does the woman believe swans could do?

choices.text: They could knock people unconscious
choices.zh: 它们能把人打昏

choices.text: They could fly against a strong wind
choices.zh: 它们能逆强风飞行

choices.text: They could sometimes terrify adults
choices.zh: 它们有时能吓到成年人

choices.text: They could break people's legs
choices.zh: 它们能打断人的腿

items.stem: What did the grandmother of the man's wife say?

choices.text: One would have curly hair if they ate too much stale bread
choices.zh: 如果吃太多不新鲜的面包就会长卷发

choices.text: One would go to prison if they put a stamp on upside down
choices.zh: 如果把邮票倒着贴就会进监狱

choices.text: One would have to shave their head to remove a bat in their hair
choices.zh: 如果头发里有蝙蝠就得剃光头才能弄出来

choices.text: One would get a spot on their tongue if they told a lie deliberately
choices.zh: 如果故意说谎舌头上就会长斑点

items.stem: Why does the speaker say he would like to relive the 1960s?

choices.text: Everything seemed to be changing.
choices.zh: 一切似乎都在变化。

choices.text: People were formal and disciplined.
choices.zh: 人们既正式又守规矩。

choices.text: People were excited to go travelling overseas.
choices.zh: 人们对去海外旅行感到兴奋。

choices.text: Things from the Victorian era came back alive.
choices.zh: 维多利亚时代的事物重新焕发生机。

items.stem: What does the speaker say was the most popular thing to do at that time?

choices.text: Watching TV at home.
choices.zh: 在家看电视。

choices.text: Meeting people.
choices.zh: 与人见面。

choices.text: Drinking coffee.
choices.zh: 喝咖啡。

choices.text: Trying new foods.
choices.zh: 尝试新食物。

items.stem: What do we learn about the speaker?

choices.text: He was interested in stylish dresses.
choices.zh: 他对时尚服装感兴趣。

choices.text: He was able to make a lot of money.
choices.zh: 他能够赚很多钱。

choices.text: He was a young student in the 1960s.
choices.zh: 他在20世纪60年代是一名年轻学生。

choices.text: He was a man full of imagination.
choices.zh: 他是一个充满想象力的人。

items.stem: What do dogs do when they are faced with angry humans?

choices.text: They avoid looking at them.
choices.zh: 它们避免看他们。

choices.text: They run away immediately.
choices.zh: 它们立即逃跑。

choices.text: They show anger on their faces.
choices.zh: 它们在脸上表现出愤怒。

choices.text: They make threatening sounds.
choices.zh: 它们发出威胁性的声音。

items.stem: What does a dog do when it sees the expressions of angry dogs?

choices.text: It turns to its owner for help.
choices.zh: 它转向主人寻求帮助。

choices.text: It turns away to avoid conflict.
choices.zh: 它转身离开以避免冲突。

choices.text: It looks away and gets angry too.
choices.zh: 它移开视线并且也变得愤怒。

choices.text: It focuses its eyes on their mouths.
choices.zh: 它将目光集中在它们的嘴部。

items.stem: How does a dog sense people's feelings?

choices.text: By observing their facial features carefully.
choices.zh: 通过仔细观察他们的面部特征。

choices.text: By focusing on a particular body movement.
choices.zh: 通过关注某一特定的身体动作。

choices.text: By taking in their facial expressions as a whole.
choices.zh: 通过整体接收他们的面部表情。

choices.text: By interpreting different emotions in different ways.
choices.zh: 通过以不同方式解读不同的情绪。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about animals in winter?

choices.text: They have to look for food and shelter underground.
choices.zh: 它们必须在地下寻找食物和庇护所。

choices.text: They take little notice of the changes in temperature.
choices.zh: 它们几乎不关注温度的变化。

choices.text: They resort to different means to survive the bitter cold.
choices.zh: 它们采取不同的方式来度过严寒。

choices.text: They have difficulty adapting to the changed environment.
choices.zh: 它们难以适应改变了的环境。

items.stem: What do we learn about animals that sleep through winter?

choices.text: They have their weight reduced to the minimum.
choices.zh: 它们的体重减少到最低限度。

choices.text: They consume energy stored before the long sleep.
choices.zh: 它们消耗长眠前储存的能量。

choices.text: They can maintain their heart beat at the normal rate.
choices.zh: 它们能够保持心跳处于正常速率。

choices.text: They can keep their body temperature warm and stable.
choices.zh: 它们能够保持体温温暖且稳定。

items.stem: How do animals like mice adapt to the severe winter?

choices.text: By staying in hiding places and eating very little.
choices.zh: 通过待在隐蔽处并吃得很少。

choices.text: By seeking food and shelter in people's houses.
choices.zh: 通过在人们的房屋里寻找食物和庇护所。

choices.text: By growing thicker hair to stay warm.
choices.zh: 通过长出更厚的毛发来保暖。

choices.text: By storing enough food beforehand.
choices.zh: 通过事先储存足够的食物。

items.stem: Why do some birds fly in groups for migrating according to the speaker?

choices.text: To stay safe.
choices.zh: 为了保持安全。

choices.text: To save energy.
choices.zh: 为了节省能量。

choices.text: To keep company.
choices.zh: 为了结伴而行。

choices.text: To protect the young.
choices.zh: 为了保护幼鸟。
